description: Resolve uses: references to immutable commit SHAs live from GitHub: actions=actions/checkout@v4,docker/login-action@v3 (up to 20), or repo=/url=/yaml= to pin every uses: in those workflows. Per action: SHA (annotated tags peeled), the exact version tag for the "# v4.2.2" comment, a ready uses: line, latest release and whether a newer major exists. Needs a CI Guard pass (0.50 USDC = 24 h, 3 USDC = 30 days + Team Kit, 8 USDC = 90 days + Team Kit, by plain USDC transfer on Base; see payment_options), or pay per call over HTTP x402 ($0.02) at /v1/gha/pin.

pass.description: Optional CI Guard pass token (rcg1...). Better: set it once as the MCP header Authorization: Bearer <token>.

ref.description: Optional branch, tag or commit SHA for repo= (default: the default branch)

repo.description: Alternative to actions: pin every uses: in this public repo's workflows (owner/name)

url.description: Alternative: https URL of one workflow file (github.com blob/raw, raw.githubusercontent.com, gist)

yaml.description: Alternative: the workflow file text itself (POST JSON {"yaml": "..."} recommended; up to 64 KB)

name: pin_actions
title: Pin actions to commit SHAs
